i18nSuggest.title: Suggest a better translation: {language}
i18nSuggest.introBeta: This language was translated by machine. Find a string that reads wrong and write it the way a native speaker would.
i18nSuggest.intro: Find the string and write a better wording.
i18nSuggest.privacy: Nothing is sent from Lumen. "Open on GitHub" opens the issue form in a new tab; you post it with your own GitHub account.
i18nSuggest.tooLong: The text is too long for a link: the issue opens with its title only. Copy the text and paste it there.
